scope: Bounded loading control only; long quality-pair timings are descriptive and individually screened, not five-pair/endurance speed acceptance. CPU time includes barriers/spin; swap counters alone do not establish stall time or causality.

prefill_observations.scope: Observed prefill intervals only; boundary polling can miss the final chunk. CPU time includes busy-wait/barriers and does not identify the hot operation. VmSwap is process accounting, not measured disk-wait time.

final_prefill_decode_bridge.scope: Missing final prefill boundary bridged to first observed decode snapshot; includes indicated generated tokens, not pure prefill timing.
